She had a good figure, light, active, and graceful. Her features were regular and well pro-
portioned. Her hair was light brown, and dressed with taste and simplicity. In her dress
she was truly simplex munditiis [simple in elegance; from Horace, Odes 1 v 15]. Her com-
plexion was beautifully transparent; the tint of the blush rose shining through the lily.
 (Peacock Works viii 95)
